---
name: Bug report
about: Report an incorrect result or installation problem
---

## What happened

Describe the expected and observed behavior.

## Environment

DreamSeed version, operating system, CPU architecture, Python version, Minecraft edition and version, and any world generation mods or data packs.

## Reproduction

Include the tool name or CLI command, request JSON, response status and caveats, and relevant error output. Share seed and coordinates only if you are comfortable making them public. For world mismatches, include whether the result was a Cubiomes prediction or an official Minecraft locate check.

## Installation checks

Include relevant output from `dreamseed-doctor --json`. Remove private paths and personal information before posting.
